title: Stock Market Today, Sept. 24: Oracle Stock Dips As it Issues Force Majeure Notice on Project Jupiter Data Center
author: Josh Kohn-Lindquist
description: Oracle stock fell 3.47% after issuing a force majeure notice for its Project Jupiter data center in New Mexico, citing construction delays and regulatory hurdles. The move signals challenges in data center development but is primarily a legal protection measure. Oracle's heavy debt load for AI infrastructure investments has raised concerns, with credit default swaps hitting record highs.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock declined 3.47% following force majeure notice on Project Jupiter data center. Concerns about high debt levels funding AI ambitions, regulatory delays, and market scrutiny on AI capex ROI weigh on investor confidence.

title: ServiceNow (NOW) Stock Falls Amid Market Uptick: What Investors Need to Know
author: Zacks.Com
description: ServiceNow stock declined 2.17% to $135.47 while the broader market gained, underperforming the S&P 500. Despite strong expected earnings growth (EPS up 7.29%, revenue up 20.27% year-over-year), the stock carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to its premium valuation at a Forward P/E of 34.1 versus the industry average of 13.72.

title: PagerDuty's 2026 Outlook: Operational Discipline and New AI Opportunities Sustains Profitable Growth Model
author: Robert Izquierdo
description: PagerDuty has achieved five consecutive quarters of GAAP profitability and generated $33 million in free cash flow, earning a Superscore of 72. However, revenue growth has stalled at less than 1% year-over-year, and the company faces competitive pressure from platform giants bundling incident response tools. The company is transitioning to consumption-based pricing and positioning AI as a growth driver to reignite expansion.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed signals: positive on achieving profitability, strong free cash flow, and capital efficiency; negative on revenue growth stagnation (less than 1% YoY), declining net retention rate (98%), and competitive threats from larger platforms. The company shows promise in AI-driven growth but faces near-term headwinds.
